Booking Holdings — peer benchmark

BKNG-peer-benchmark-2026-10-06 · USD · series 2026-10-07T16:15:00Z · built 2026-10-07 16:23 UTC

The short version

Travelers pay Booking when they book a stay or other travel through its brands. Expedia, Airbnb, and Trip.com take the same kind of booking — hotel, home, or package — with different inventory and geography weight. Expedia is the closest large OTA peer on stays and packages. Airbnb is the homes and direct-to-guest alternative. Trip.com is the major international OTA with Asia weight, reporting in CNY on Form 20-F.

Booking is the largest USD revenue print in the set. Trip.com stays blank on the dollar charts and has its own CNY panel.

Operating income is the honest profit line. Margin is that line divided by revenue (DERIVED). Trip.com’s CNY margin sits on the percent chart because the ratio is currency-neutral.

Diluted weighted-average shares are CORE from SoT. Booking is split-adjusted. Trip.com’s ~FY2021 ADS-scale jump is printed as filed. Trip.com has no quarterly WAS print.

Diluted EPS growth is year-over-year on the same object (DERIVED). Trip.com stays blank — diluted EPS SoT is stale.

Open gaps

  • Trip.com has no USD revenue or operating-income print — blank on those charts; CNY panel only.
  • Trip.com weekly trailing PE is blank (CNY 20-F; no house USD TTM PE).
  • Trip.com diluted EPS growth is blank on every label (stale SoT; not invented).
  • Trip.com quarterly diluted WAS is blank (annual-only in SoT).
  • Forward PE is empty for every name — not invented.
  • Geography, inventory mix, room nights, GBV, and take rate are not on this page — peers lack the same printable object in the cabinet this cut.
  • Airbnb FY2020 annual revenue and operating income are blank in SoT.
  • Booking diluted WAS before FY2023 is blank in SoT.
